sources.snippet: ROCmFPX adds experimental AMD-focused 2-, 3-, 4-, 6-, and 8-bit GGUF model-weight formats to llama.cpp, with CPU reference paths and accelerated HIP/ROCm and Vulkan kernels. Status: ROCmFPX is an experimental feature family on the canonical main branch. APIs, tuning choices, and performance can change. sources.snippet: Our private CarbonX AI tool. Combines advanced neural networks on a secondary PC with a physical Arduino that is spoofed to match 1:1 with a real mouse to negate detections.
